title: Replicating adversarial neutralization of a steering vector via crafted inputs

original_idea.body: Set up a steered model, then search for input prompts (templates/suffixes) that restore the unsteered behavior, measuring what fraction of steering is neutralized.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: prompt-level neutralization of safety steering shows the defense is brittle.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Red-team robustness on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Neutralization partly shown; beginner replication may be partly open. Overlaps gen-1377.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: This replication may be partly open.
